. MY THOUGHTS OF THE MERGE SO FAR: This merge has moved very quickly & has not been cagey whatsoever. Dicy & I already mentioned when we got to merge, that we could work with Swiss, Toast, & Keira as they were all from our OG tribes & we’re working together. As soon as we merged, I immediately made it a point to talk to Keira first. And it became very clear that even though I hadn’t met Swiss & Toast in game, that we were gonna make a very strong 5 off the bat. I know Toast from S6, so it also helped to get us bonded very quickly, & that led to me meeting Swiss. Even without Toast, I think I would have LOVED Swiss. Swiss and I have instantly bonded over just liking each other, both being chaotic, and both being villains. SWISS AND I WERE FUCKING MADE FOR EACH OTHER! I also have connections from the Pizza tribe to Phoebe, Pie, & Crystal. I’ve been gunning for Phoebe & Pie pretty hard for a while now because I can tell they are an obvious duo and haven’t really cared to work with me game wise, they’re just using me as a number and would of got rid of me if they needed too. I always knew Crystal was a loose 3 for them, but I’m not sure where Crystal stands now exactly. The scary part about this merge is that Pie & Phoebe reconnected with Gage, who is also close to Arvid. Gage and Crystal also have a good connection. So, although I want to work with Crystal, I’m not sure if Crystal would vote them out yet. As of now, my target hit list is one of Phoebe, Pie, Gage, or Arvid. None of them are benefitting my game in a huge way right now, & I’d love to take the first shot at merge and make them scared of me. But the real question is, how will we get one of them out? The answer is, Max & potentially Crystal. With Max, I’m not approaching this as a, “oh we need to flip him.” I’m playing up to Max like we are on the bottom and need to find a home. Max will be more incentivized to work with me if he also feels I have nothing to work with. He doesn’t know about the 5 person alliance that consists of Myself / Swiss / Toast / Dicy / Keira, of course, but I still want him on my side here and potentially for the future. Crystal is a hard one, like I said earlier I want Crystal on my side here, but I don’t know if he would be open to taking a shot at a Katsudon member so early, considering he’s had beef with edamame before. So I’m gonna see what I can get away with, but it’s a question mark for now. And, I know for this vote if it goes the way I want & a Katsudon leaves, it’s going to heavily fracture my relationship with the other Katsudon’s, and I’ll have to figure out a way to rebuild it. But right now, my main focus is the 5 person alliance I’m in. But I don’t want that to just be my safe bet. This 5 person alliance isn’t gonna stick the whole time, & we all know that. When the alliance breaks, I want to be the one who has the hammer, and not the one being smashed. Who I trust the most to least: 1st, Keira: I want her on my side for the whole game, she’s crucial. 2nd, Dicy: I think for now, Dicy has my back. I think Dicy will try & make a move later, but I’m prepared for when it happens. 3rd, Toast: Obviously I have a bias with Toast since we played, but I don’t see any reason why Toast would want me out soon here. 4th, Swiss: Swiss is on the bottom of the alliance trust for me, just because I think Swiss is insanely smart & wouldn’t hesitate to take me down if needed. I think Swiss is someone I can trust for now though. 5th, Crystal: Right now, Crystal is kinda floating in between very high and low for me, so they’ll stay in the middle for now. This vote will show me how Crystal and I’s future looks like.

Dicy & I already mentioned when we got to merge, that we could work with Swiss, Toast, & Keira as they were all from our OG tribes & we’re working together. As soon as we merged, I immediately made it a point to talk to Keira first. And it became very clear that even though I hadn’t met Swiss & Toast in game, that we were gonna make a very strong 5 off the bat. I know Toast from S6, so it also helped to get us bonded very quickly, & that led to me meeting Swiss. Even without Toast, I think I would have LOVED Swiss. Swiss and I have instantly bonded over just liking each other, both being chaotic, and both being villains. SWISS AND I WERE FUCKING MADE FOR EACH OTHER! I also have connections from the Pizza tribe to Phoebe, Pie, & Crystal. I’ve been gunning for Phoebe & Pie pretty hard for a while now because I can tell they are an obvious duo and haven’t really cared to work with me game wise, they’re just using me as a number and would of got rid of me if they needed too. I always knew Crystal was a loose 3 for them, but I’m not sure where Crystal stands now exactly. The scary part about this merge is that Pie & Phoebe reconnected with Gage, who is also close to Arvid. Gage and Crystal also have a good connection. So, although I want to work with Crystal, I’m not sure if Crystal would vote them out yet. As of now, my target hit list is one of Phoebe, Pie, Gage, or Arvid. None of them are benefitting my game in a huge way right now, & I’d love to take the first shot at merge and make them scared of me. But the real question is, how will we get one of them out? The answer is, Max & potentially Crystal. With Max, I’m not approaching this as a, “oh we need to flip him.” I’m playing up to Max like we are on the bottom and need to find a home. Max will be more incentivized to work with me if he also feels I have nothing to work with. He doesn’t know about the 5 person alliance that consists of Myself / Swiss / Toast / Dicy / Keira, of course, but I still want him on my side here and potentially for the future. Crystal is a hard one, like I said earlier I want Crystal on my side here, but I don’t know if he would be open to taking a shot at a Katsudon member so early, considering he’s had beef with edamame before. So I’m gonna see what I can get away with, but it’s a question mark for now. And, I know for this vote if it goes the way I want & a Katsudon leaves, it’s going to heavily fracture my relationship with the other Katsudon’s, and I’ll have to figure out a way to rebuild it. But right now, my main focus is the 5 person alliance I’m in. But I don’t want that to just be my safe bet. This 5 person alliance isn’t gonna stick the whole time, & we all know that. When the alliance breaks, I want to be the one who has the hammer, and not the one being smashed. Who I trust the most to least: 1st, Keira: I want her on my side for the whole game, she’s crucial. 2nd, Dicy: I think for now, Dicy has my back. I think Dicy will try & make a move later, but I’m prepared for when it happens. 3rd, Toast: Obviously I have a bias with Toast since we played, but I don’t see any reason why Toast would want me out soon here. 4th, Swiss: Swiss is on the bottom of the alliance trust for me, just because I think Swiss is insanely smart & wouldn’t hesitate to take me down if needed. I think Swiss is someone I can trust for now though. 5th, Crystal: Right now, Crystal is kinda floating in between very high and low for me, so they’ll stay in the middle for now. This vote will show me how Crystal and I’s future looks like.

. POWER RANKINGS 1st. Dicy I think Dicy is in a similar position to me & is just as dangerous. I think Dicy is set up to do extremely good this season, and I think he could very well win this game. He has the connections to do it, & he has the social game to back it up. 2nd: Crystal I think Crystal is a silent killer to win. Crystal might not be in the majority alliance nor seem like he’s the one in ‘charge,’ but I think he is capable of flipping people to make a majority & taking over the game. I want Crystal close, but I know he’s dangerous. 3rd: Swiss I think Swiss is a very social and intelligent player. I’d say Swiss is easily one of the most social, & one of the most dangerous players left. I think Swiss is known to be a big player though, & that could get her in trouble. I think Swiss has the capabilities to get to the end if I’m not careful. 4th: Toast I think Toast is seen as a ‘less threat’ than Swiss, which arguably makes Toast a bigger threat to win IMO. But I think if Toast stays with Swiss the whole time, Swiss will be probably awarded over Toast. But I think Toast is another player who could slip under the radar and potentially get a win. 5th: Gage I think Gage is in a bad spot rn, but he’s confirmed to be making it to next round and if he gets any traction in this game, he could take it to the end. Although Pie seemed ‘upset’ with Gage, I think Gage could still be respected by a jury. 6th: Arvid Arvid hasn’t played a very flashy game yet, and he also has been getting a reputation this season of being a leaker, so I feel his chances of being respected by a jury are less so than the others. However, I think Arvid could still win a jury vote in the right case. I think Arvid could potentially be a jury social threat if he plays the nice, loyal role until FTC. 7th: Max I could definitely see Max going up in the future, but for now I think Max is being seen a little negatively based off my chats with Phoebe & Pie. I feel Max is smart enough though to kick it up a notch and 100% become a stronger player soon. 8th: Keira Tbh, although Keira is this low I still think she could win. How I feel the jurors feel about me overall: Pie: Pie is the hardest juror for me to read since I didn’t get as much time with her. I think Pie’s view on the game is largely gonna come down to what she hears from the other jurors. I feel Pie would respect my game, but if the jury is not happy with me, she may go along with that & not want to vote me. Phoebe: One of my biggest regrets in the game is how I handled Phoebe’s vote out. I feel like I should have shut my mouth and I became hypocritical in how I spoke to her. I wouldn’t be surprised if she was hurt or turned off from voting me. Crystal: I think Crystal is a very game savvy player who would probably respect game the most, but I could see a world where Crystal doesn’t respect my game. I would lean on her would, but it’s hard to tell. Max: I feel Max would also respect game the most, but after he knows that I was lying to him a LOT and playing him, he might not be supporting me if he feels hurt by it or thinks it was unnecessary. Swiss: She seemed very upset with me after my idol play, but I feel when I clear up I was aligned with Dicy the whole time & my game in general, she’d hopefully respect it. But if she’s upset & doesn’t like how I play, then I most likely won’t get her vote. Toast: This is a hard one- because Toast and I have that S6 connection & I was genuine about potentially bringing Toast to the final 3, which I’ll make clear. Toast may not like how I handled his vote out, and may be hurt about how I played the game. I feel there’s a chance there though that I could get it. Gage: Tbh, I don’t see Gage really voting me in any scenario. I think Gage usually likes voting the people he was closest too- and we were not very close at all. If Arvid is at the FTC, he 100% votes him. Dicy: If I voted out Dicy, I think he’d be EXTREMELY blindsided and hurt. Which could mean 2 things: he could either respect it and & vote me to win, or he will think I took the coward way out and not respect it. I’d lean towards Dicy respecting my game & voting me. Arvid: if I voted out Arvid, I think there’s no world where I get his jury vote. He’s made it clear that I’ve upset him & I don’t think he’d want to see me win because he doesn’t like me.

Devan 3/5/2025 8:32 PM
I just wanna say one thing before the jury questioning starts- I want to say thank you to all of production for inviting me back & letting me get to experience Snackvivor for the THIRD time. I feel so honored, and each season has been some of the most fun I’ve had in any orgs. I’m so happy that you guys wanted me back, and I hope I gave you guys at least a bit of fun this season. If I win or lose, this is a season I will never, ever forget, and something that will stick with me forever. This season has the distinction of being my first discord org where I made a FTC, and that in itself is a huge accomplishment. I know there’s a chance I may not win, and I’m prepared for that incase so I’m not too disappointed. But, I will fight to the bitter end to convince these jurors that I am deserving to win. I had amazing moments in this season, I personally feel I played a solid game, and it’s a game that I’ve wanted to play for all my seasons, that I’ve never been able to truly fulfill until now. I met amazing people, the challenges even though I struggled in them were so fun to go through, and overall this season was just amazingly made. I went crazy a lot, I still am, I’ve been stressed out, but I wouldn’t change anything I’ve gone through this season. After having a mediocre game in my last org, this was the perfect potion for me. Thank you all for letting me play, and all for watching me. I’ve had a fucking blast!
